_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G1: Restarted to apply Automatic Cold Detection option!
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G10: When your character is idle, they will often have random subtle expressions.\n
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G11: Your character will react to being cold depending on your 'cold-manager' mod.\n
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G12: When out of Stamina, your character will be out of breath.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G13: During low health, your character will be in pain/scared.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G14: After drinking alcohol, your character will be 'happy' for 1 to 2 hours.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G15: After taking skooma, your character will have \na random happier-than-usual expression for 1 to 2 hours.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G16: When not at home, your character will have \nan embarrassed expression when wearing no clothes.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G17: Your character will squint their eyes \nand look at their surroundings when sneaking.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G18: Your character will squint their eyes \nwhen swimming or diving underwater.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G19: If for some reason the face of your character \nis glitched, click here to reset it back to normal.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G2: Default expression restored - If in the middle of a face animation, expression will be restored once animation is finished.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G20: Clicking here will stop all functionalities of the mod.\nDo this ONLY if you are planning on uninstalling the mod right after.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G21: The Automatic option scans your load order for frostfall or frostbite. Change this manually only\nif you have switched from one mod to another or want to use the vanilla detection method.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G22: Clicking here will stop and restart the mod's functionalities.\nThis is useful if you have updated to a new version.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G23: Your character will have a 'headache' look when almost out of mana.\nSame look will be applied when you have a disease.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G24: When out of stamina, you can hear your character (quietly) breathing\n heavily until they recover half of their stamina. Enables trauma sounds as well
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G25: Your character will react to trauma or disease (painful subtle expressions).\n There's also a pain sound once in a while
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G26: Your character will react to dirt (disgusted subtle expressions).\n Integrated with Dirt&Blood,Keep it clean,Bathing in Skyrim
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G27: Your character will react to arousal (pleasure subtle expressions).\n Integrated with OSL Aroused
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G28: Verbose debug notifications. Shows what emotion is playing
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G3: Mod is now prepared to be uninstalled. Please, exit menu, save and uninstall. Keep in mind: It's never 100% safe to uninstall mods mid-game, always make back-ups of your saves before installing mods!
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G30: Clicking here will register new followers. Followers are also registered when game is loaded.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G32: Update period for long term conditions checking. Set to 0 if you want to disable them
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G36: You and your followers keep reacting through a conversation, instead of the mod standing down for all of it. Whoever is actually speaking keeps their mouth: your character keeps the rest of the face, and a talking NPC is left alone until their line ends. Worth turning on with a player voice mod or a dialogue camera.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G37: Followers keep reacting through a conversation too. A talking NPC is never written over - their line already animates their whole face - so expressions land in the gaps, while you read the topic list. Turn this off if NPC faces look wrong between lines: their own dialogue mood is what gets replaced.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G4: Please, exit menu. All functionalities will be restarted.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G6: Please, exit menu. Followers were registered
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G8: Quick and slow refer to how fast your character starts chewing.\nDepending on your eating animation mod, one or the other will fit better.
line:mcm_flick_translation/CEE:Condition.$CEE_G9: This enables a more focused combat expression. Disabling this will revert back\n to the vanilla combat expression. Cannot be disabled during combat
